scene: Playroom floor. A toy truck sits on a short curved track at center; Child kneels at screen-right and Peer kneels at screen-left, both with empty hands. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot at floor level with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: A brief friendly disagreement stays calm; Child proposes with open hands; both end satisfied and ready to play.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: The truck rests on the track center; Child and Peer kneel facing each other with empty hands.
clips.action: Peer hugs the truck lightly to his chest while claiming every turn. Child holds both palms open while saying it is not fair; Peer points at the truck and track while explaining they are his.
clips.end: Peer keeps one hand on the truck; Child waits with open hands.

clips.start: Peer keeps one hand on the truck; Child waits with open hands.
clips.action: Child traces one slow lap around the track with his finger while making his offer. Peer scrunches his face, then shrugs; Child draws one quick lap with his finger for the fast version.
clips.end: Both look at the truck on the track, nodding toward the plan.

clips.start: Both look at the truck on the track, nodding toward the plan.
clips.action: Peer lifts the truck and offers it toward the middle of the track. Child taps the track once and mimes a small mouth for saying the switch word; both laugh gently and sit ready at their sides.
clips.end: The truck stands at track center between the two kneeling children; both rest their hands on their knees with friendly smiles.
